question: Does the pre-download-frozen door-8 family supply three complementary target views on each side before any RGB or model access?

selection.memory: Greedily add maximum newly visible target vertices; ties use larger short-side fraction, higher depth-visible ratio, then earlier frame.
selection.sibling: Record the first different door or doorframe instance with an admitted view; its appearance is forbidden from target-only ranking.

next_action.evaluable: Freeze three target views per side, then run the unchanged layer-18, reference-scale 0.05 and full-proposal extent-retention 0.8 chain once.
next_action.not_evaluable: Retain the source receipt and do not open RGB or call GroundingDINO, DINOv2 or SAM2 for this family.

forbidden_after_freeze: change family, target, view rules, memory budget, tiles, reference-scale penalty or extent-retention rule
reinterpret source scarcity as algorithm failure
claim_boundary: This source gate can establish only whether the new family supplies three-view target memory. It is not algorithm evidence, referent binding, named entrance, ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, benefit, reliability or safety.
